text: APPROVE: The extracted helpers keep the same Create/Apply matching, the same (0,1)/(1,0)/skip ordering logic, and the same invocation and return semantics, and the `is var (eventIndex, documentIndex)` pattern on the nullable tuple compiles and skips on null, as the old `continue` did. `BuildPlan` is now well under 15 (a foreach, two ifs and a few `&&`s), and I see no new compiler warnings; I haven't run the build, so a stylistic analyzer rule such as constant-before-method ordering is the one thing I couldn't rule out.
